questions.question: What is a Tool Selection Matrix?
choices: A list of all available AI tools
A structured comparison table with criteria, scoring, and recommendations
A tutorial for using a specific tool
questions.explanation: A Tool Selection Matrix is a structured comparison with defined criteria (speed, accuracy, cost, etc.), a scoring system, and recommendations for different use cases.

questions.question: Why should you not give subjective scores like 'Claude is better because I like it'?
choices: Scores should be based on objective, measurable criteria
questions.explanation: A useful matrix requires objective, measurable criteria so the comparison is fair and reproducible. Personal preference doesn't help others make decisions.

questions.question: Why should the tool matrix be updated regularly?
choices: To keep the document looking fresh
AI tools evolve rapidly — new features, pricing, and capabilities change frequently
questions.explanation: AI tools develop quickly. New features, updated pricing, and changed capabilities mean an outdated matrix can lead to poor tool selection decisions.
